```sql
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN r."year" = 2010 THEN COALESCE(ps.points, 0) ELSE 0 END)
  - SUM(CASE WHEN r."year" = 2009 THEN COALESCE(ps.points, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS season_points_delta
FROM results res
JOIN races r ON res."raceId" = r."raceId"
JOIN drivers d ON res."driverId" = d."driverId"
LEFT JOIN points_scheme ps ON res."positionOrder" = ps."position" AND ps."scheme_id" = CASE WHEN r."year" >= 2010 THEN 'PS2010' ELSE 'PS2009' END
WHERE d."driverRef" = 'button'
  AND r."year" IN (2009, 2010);
```
